name: Nurse ni Omakase
source:
Main character works part-time at a convenience store. Nurses often come to this shop to buy lunches. One day protagonist gets to a hospital and meets the same nurses! He gets one step closer to realizing his hidden desires.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-september-2004-abandoner.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公在一家便利店打工，平日里常有护士光顾店里购买午餐。某天，主人公因故前往医院，竟在院内与那群熟悉的护士不期而遇！距离实现内心深处不可告人的欲望，他又迈近了一步。

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-september-2004-abandoner.html]vndbreview[/url]]
